run_smplify_fitting_on_coco: run smplifyAllWrapper with coco dataset and pretrained checkpoint to fit SMPL bodies on all images
run_exemplar_training_on_dataset: run exemplarTrainerWrapper with a pretrained checkpoint to perform EFT fine-tuning on a dataset
run_smplify_on_single_batch: run EFTFitter.run_smplify on a single image batch to get optimized SMPL pose and shape parameters
run_eft_fitting_on_database: run EFTFitter.eftAllInDB to perform exemplar fine-tuning and export fitted SMPL results as pickle files
configure_smplify_training_options: configure TrainOptions with argparse params to set pretrained checkpoint, batch size, and dataset for SMPL fitting
